STAFF SELECTION COMMISSION
NOTICE
COMBINED GRADUATE LEVEL EXAMINATION, 2026
F. No. HQ-PPI03/11/2026-PP_1

Dates for submission of online applications: 11.06.2026 to 10.07.2026
Last date for submission: 10.07.2026
Tentative vacancies: Approximately 14582.
Tier-I Examination: September-October 2026.
Tier-II Examination: December 2026.
The Staff Selection Commission will hold the Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 for filling up of various Group 'B' and Group 'C' posts in different Ministries/Departments/Organizations of Government of India.
